summary: Pinned-session rebind blocked by edge circuit lock after autoscaler rollback during canary shift
description:
Issue summary:
During a planned canary traffic shift for a pinned model rollout for BrightHealth AI, an autoscaler-triggered rollback on a small subset of dedicated nodes caused the edge proxy's circuit state to become 'locked' for a short window. The locked state prevented pinned session rebinds when the promoted model returned to stable capacity, forcing routing to fall back to the customer's configured fallback model.

Impact:
- ~12% of active pinned sessions for the customer in us-west-2 observed responses from the fallback model for 7 minutes.
- Customer reports inconsistent outputs and downstream validation failures for production workflows (patient-safety scoring).
- No data leakage observed; this is routing/availability impact only.

Environment:
prod us-west-2, Dedicated cluster dh-prod-2, edge-proxy pool ep-usw2-a, serving-runtime v1.12.3, autoscaler v0.9.7

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1. Start gradual canary weight shift (10% -> 100%) for redwood/rwkv-13b-v2 on dh-prod-2.
2. Autoscaler triggers scale-in due to spot eviction on 2 nodes and immediately rolls back a subset of canary placements.
3. Edge-proxy circuit for affected sessions flips to TRIPPED state then becomes STALE-LOCK for new binds.
4. On subsequent requests, session affinity lookup fails to rebind to pinned model; routing selects fallback route per policy.

Observed logs / evidence:
- ep-usw2-a/proxy.log: "circuit[session-*-bh] state=STALE_LOCK duration=00:07:12"
- routing-service: "session-rebind attempt failed: affinity-cache-miss + circuit-lock"
- serving-runtime metrics: brief spike in fallback-route-requests for customer_id=brighthealth (2026-03-13T18:05:00Z)
- Customer complaint window: 2026-03-13T18:06:00Z -> 18:13:00Z

Investigation notes:
- Hypothesis A: Edge proxy maintains transient circuit state across scale events; rollback left an inconsistent state where rebinds were rate-limited by a stale lock TTL that didn't get cleared on placement restore.
- Hypothesis B: Autoscaler rollback triggers a short-lived version mismatch between control-plane route cache and edge-proxy local state leading to affinity-resolution failures.
- Early root-cause indicators point to stale lock TTL in edge-proxy combined with race between placement restore and route cache invalidation.

Actions taken so far:
- Support acknowledged at 18:09 and escalated to SRE and serving-runtime on-call.
- SRE cleared edge-proxy circuit entries for ep-usw2-a at 18:12 which restored normal rebind behavior.
- Temporary mitigation: increased circuit invalidation frequency to 30s for affected pool, and applied a one-off rule to prefer route cache bounce on scale/rollback events.
- Customer notified with interim status at 18:18.

Next steps / open work:
- Engagement requested from infra runtime team to add a guard to clear stale circuit locks when a model placement transitions from ROLLING_BACK to ACTIVE. (Owner: infra-runtime)
- Add a control-plane broadcast that invalidates edge proxy affinity cache on canary rollback/scale events. (Owner: routing)
- Post-incident: run chaos test simulating spot evictions during canary shifts to validate fix. (Owner: SRE)
- Add monitoring alert: sudden delta between pinned-session count and routing-success-rate for a customer >5% for >2m. (Owner: observability)

Resolution notes / timeline:
- Temporary mitigation applied and confirmed restored for BrightHealth AI by 18:20 on 2026-03-13.
- No further customer complaints after 18:22.
- Working on permanent fix; ETA for code change and rollout: 2026-03-22.

References:
- Slack: #support thread: https://slack.redwood.ai/support/pinned-rebind-660217
- Incident dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/CanaryTraffic/660217
